svg.title: Ultrasonic: Beyond Hearing — visual representation of inaudible sound frequencies
svg.desc: Dense waveforms, bat echolocation sweeps, dog whistle pulses, and particle fields representing ultrasonic frequencies invisible to human hearing
svg.text: Frequencies that exist in space, unfelt, unheard — only seen here
Cycles compressed so tight they blur into texture
FM sweep — 100 kHz down to 40 kHz in 5 milliseconds
23–54 kHz — inaudible to humans, sharp and directional to dogs
Standing waves suspend matter — a force invisible to the eye
